The '''Mandalorian Trat'ade''' was a coalition of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian clans]] that emerged in the aftermath of the [[Eternal Empire conquest|Eternal Empire's conquest of the galaxy]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]], the surviving clans rallied under the leadership of [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]], who assumed the [[Mandalore (title)|title]] "Mandalore the Avenger." Under her command, the Trat'ade aligned with the [[Eternal Alliance]], contributing their martial prowess to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]'s recovery efforts after the [[war against Zakuul]].

==History==
===Formation===
{{Quote|We've been under siege these past few years. Clan Vizla survived better than most. I ended up Mandalore mostly by accident.|Mandalore the Avenger explaining the situation with Mandalorians against the Eternal Empire|<ref name="Mandalorian Weapons">{{TORcite|type=codex|Mandalorian Weapons}}</ref>}}
In the wake of the [[Eternal Empire]]'s devastating campaign, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian clans]] found themselves fragmented and leaderless. Recognizing the need for unity, [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] stepped forward to lead, earning the [[Mandalore (title)|title]] "Mandalore the Avenger" during her resistance against Zakuul within the besieged [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian Heartworlds]]<ref name="TOR" /> . Under her leadership, she formed a new coalition<ref name="KotFE 14" /> known as the Mandalorian Trat'ade&mdash;with ''trat'ade'' meaning "forces"<ref name="Track">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|"Mandalorian Trat'ade on Ruhnuk" Reputation Track}}</ref> in the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Her leadership marked the first significant victory for the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] in six [[Standard month/Legends|months]], reinvigorating their fighting spirit and consolidating their strength under the Trat'ade banner.<ref name="KotFE 14" />

The Trat'ade quickly became the dominant Mandalorian faction, integrating advanced technologies and strategies to bolster their capabilities. Their alliance with the [[Eternal Alliance]] further solidified their position as a formidable force in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="KotFE 14" />

===War against Zakuul===
In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Chapter 14 Date">{{TOR_updates|4.5}}</ref> the Mandalorian Trat'ade played a pivotal role in the [[Raid on Darvannis]], a strategic assault against the Eternal Empire. The objective was to capture the [[GEMINI Prime]], the template for the [[Eternal Fleet]]'s droid commanders. Mandalore the Avenger led the operation, with key figures such as [[Torian Cadera]] and [[Khomo Fett]] orchestrating ground assaults and sabotage missions. The successful capture of GEMINI Prime marked a significant turning point in the war, bolstering the Alliance's capabilities against the Eternal Empire.<ref name="KotFE 14" />

The Trat'ade's commitment to the Eternal Alliance was further demonstrated during the [[Invasion of Voss]]. When [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] launched an assault on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], seeking her mother [[Senya Tirall]], the Mandalorians, under the command of Torian Cadera, were instrumental in repelling the attack. Collaborating with Alliance forces, they defended key locations, including the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]] and the [[Shrine of Healing]], ensuring the safety of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] people and the preservation of their culture.<ref name="KotET 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=1}}</ref>

===Civil war erupts===
Despite their successes, tensions within the Trat'ade began to surface. Mandalore the Avenger's decisions, including the slighting of clans like [[Clan Ha'rangir]] and the exile of others, led to dissent among the ranks. This discontent gave rise to the [[Hidden Chain]], a faction led by [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] [[Heta Kol]], aiming to overthrow Shae's leadership and restore traditional Mandalorian values.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>

The ideological divide between the Trat'ade and the Hidden Chain escalated into a full blown [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|civil war]], threatening the stability of the Mandalorian people and drawing the attention of external powers.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

===Change of leadership===
Concerned that the internal conflict would provoke intervention from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Mandalore the Avenger made the difficult decision to abdicate her title. She transferred control of her forces to [[Jekiah Ordo]], believing him to be instrumental in locating and confronting Heta Kol.<ref name="Sundering" />

In a controversial move, Shae Vizla [[Malgus's escape|liberated]] [[Darth Malgus]] from his [[Prison/Legends|prison]], effectively severing ties with the Eternal Alliance and marking a significant turning point in Mandalorian politics.<ref name="Sundering" /> This move angered the Mandalorian clans aligned with Shae, the Eternal Alliance and its key allies.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Desperate Defiance|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>

Following this operation, leadership of the Trat'ade fell to [[Jekiah Ordo]], accompanied by [[Rass Ordo|his brother]]. The two took the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'' to Odessen in order to meet with the [[Eternal Alliance]] after Shae's decision. Upon exiting the ship in the hangar of the Alliance base, the Mandalorians were greeted with Alliance troops with their weapons aimed at them and a furious [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]] who demanded answers.<ref name="Galactic Threads">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Galactic Threads|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>

Jekiah told them that they could deal with Shae later as he brought news of a potential [[Hidden Chain]] defector on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|On the Run|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> and a [[Greb Besrik|member of Shae's mercenary team]], who helped free Malgus, on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="Hoth Pursuit">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Hoth Pursuit|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref> as a means of stopping the Hidden Chain and finding Shae Vizla.<ref name="Galactic Threads" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalorian Trat'ade first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''. The coalition was later identified as the "Mandalorian Trat'ade" in the reputation track for the [[Ruhnuk]] daily area missions, introduced in Game Update 7.2: ''Showdown on Ruhnuk'' as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', released on [[December 13]], [[2022]].<ref name="Track" />
